title: Blind Men and the Elephant: Diverse Perspectives on Gender Stereotypes in Benchmark Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating pseudo-log-likelihood (PLL) differences in masked language models for stereotyped versus anti-stereotyped sentence pairs that differ exclusively by gender terms (gender-swapping). The evaluation also classifies these biases into four specific sub-dimensions: personality traits, attitudes and beliefs, roles and behaviors, and physical characteristics.
